title: Bessent Dares Traders On Yen, Rhee Says Don't Panic Over Won Moves | The Asia Trade 9/9/2026
description:
"Bloomberg: The Asia Trade" brings you everything you need to know to get ahead as the trading day begins in Asia. Bloomberg TV is live from Tokyo and Sydney with Avril Hong and Haidi Stroud-Watts, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders on the biggest stories shaping global markets.

Chapters:
00:00:00 - Bloomberg: The Asia Trade begins
00:01:34 - Bessent to yen traders: I am the house now
00:03:08 - Bessent to reveal Treasury buyback size
00:07:15 - Oil prices rise after US attacks Iranian tankers
00:12:19 - Lombard Odier's Homin Lee on global markets outlook
00:18:52 - Former US Trade Representative Susan Schwab on US-Canada trade tensions
00:26:10 - Global bond rush builds as issuers race to avoid headwinds
00:29:27 - DigitalBridge CEO Marc Ganzi on business and growth outlook
00:38:03 - Meta debuts AI assistant for personal tasks and organization
00:41:44 - Rising JGB yields revive capital repatriation debate
00:47:23 - Markets open in Japan, South Korea and Australia
00:49:28 - Gavekal CEO Louis-Vincent Gave on market strategy
01:00:05 - Bessent dares traders to bet against yen
01:04:06 - US forces say they destroyed five Iranian tankers
01:07:49 - Former US Trade Representative Susan Schwab on Canada tariffs
01:12:08 - Former Bank of Korea Governor Rhee Chang Yong reacts to Bessent's Yen comments
01:28:19 - ASML wins over TSMC, Samsung for new EUV tools
01:31:59 - China stocks show signs of nearing short-term bottom
